requirements_summary: Workload: customer-facing chat agents with tool-calling (search, order lookup, ticket update)
Latency SLO: 95th percentile end-to-end streaming < 300ms (NA target easier, EU challenging)
Throughput: sustained 150-300 concurrent sessions during peak, bursts to 500
Model prefs: open/Redwood-curated models; willing to test smaller variants as fallback (7B/13B) and a 70B for quality checks
Routing/fallback: require smart routing across NA/EU, automatic fallback to compatible model variant or degraded mode to maintain availability
Streaming & tool calling: must support streaming tokens + function/tool calling with low overhead for first-byte and tail latency
Security: SSO (SAML), Audit logs, KMS integration, EU data residency for EU customer data
next_step: Complete POC latency tests (regional routing + fallback) by 2026-03-10; SE to produce routing config and run canary; AE to deliver Dedicated price proposal by 2026-03-15.
